q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The question asks for forward guidance issued in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026. Today is August 19, 2026, so **7 days remain** until the guidance is announced.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance for Q2 FY2027:
- **Official guidance: $91.0 billion ± 2%** (released May 20, 2026 in Q1 earnings)
- This implies a range of **$89.18 billion to $92.82 billion**
- Analyst consensus is slightly higher at approximately **$91.846 billion**

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will maintain or slightly adjust its existing $91.0B guidance when it reports Q2 FY2027 results in 7 days. Companies rarely make major revisions to forward guidance between announcement and earnings release unless there's been a material change in business conditions.

Key supporting factors:
1. Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6B (85% YoY growth) - strong momentum
2. Data Center revenue reached $75.2B in Q1 - driving the growth
3. Guidance explicitly assumes **zero China Data Center revenue** - a conservative assumption that provides some margin for upside if restrictions ease
4. The ±2% range provides built-in flexibility

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Demand deterioration**: If enterprise AI spending suddenly slows (requires major macro shift)
- **Supply constraints easing without demand**: If GPU supply increases faster than expected demand grows
- **Geopolitical escalation**: Further restrictions on China sales, though already assumed at zero
- **Competitive pressure**: If AMD or other competitors take meaningful share (unlikely given NVIDIA's dominance)
- **Conservative reset**: Management could lower guidance to increase beat probability (market timing strategy)

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **China restrictions easing**: Current guidance assumes zero China revenue; any relaxation is upside
- **AI accelerator demand exceeding expectations**: Enterprise adoption accelerating faster than modeled
- **ASP (Average Selling Price) strength**: Mix shift toward higher-margin H100/H200 products
- **Beat-and-raise pattern**: Management could guide higher to demonstrate confidence
- **Analyst consensus upside**: $91.846B analyst estimate slightly exceeds $91.0B guidance midpoint

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

**Historical reference from research provided:**
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: **$81.6 billion**
- Q1 FY2027 forward guidance for Q2: **$91.0 billion** (official) / **$91.846 billion** (analyst consensus)
- This implies ~11.4% sequential growth (Q1 to Q2)

NVIDIA's guidance has historically been conservative and typically results in beats. With $81.6B in Q1, the $91.0B Q2 guidance represents an 11.4% sequential step—reasonable given strong AI demand momentum but not extreme.

---

## Probability Distribution Reasoning

The guidance of $91.0B ± 2% ($89.18B-$92.82B) was set 3+ months ago and remains the official forward guidance. With 7 days until announcement:

- **60-70% probability**: Guidance stays at $91.0B (most stable outcome)
- **15-20% probability**: Slightly raised guidance ($91.5B-$93B range, reflecting upside opportunities)
- **10-15% probability**: Maintained but earnings beat the $91.0B midpoint
- **5-10% probability**: Lowered guidance (unlikely unless major negative development)

The analyst consensus at $91.846B is importantly **higher** than the $91.0B midpoint, suggesting room for upside surprise.

NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, predicts approximately $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance explicitly assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/).

Analyst consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is slightly higher, with some aggregators pegging it closer to $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). The company's Q1 FY2027 revenue, reported on May 20, 2026, was $81.6 billion, an 85% increase from a year ago [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This record revenue was driven by a strong demand for AI infrastructure, with Data Center revenue reaching $75.2 billion in Q1 FY2027 [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). NVIDIA will report its Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026 [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).
